column1: # symbol = the call exactly as in old bytecode (see rose analyze). Shims for vanilla changes live in eras/era-1.20.1
# (rose.era.v1_20_1.shim); shims for Forge extensions of vanilla classes live in the dialect (rose.dialect.forge.v1_20_1.shim).
# Instance calls pass the receiver as the shim's first argument. Every rule needs evidence.

column3: 1.20.1 ItemStack.is(Item) = getItem() == item; 26.3 only has is(Predicate<Holder<Item>>); getItem() unchanged

Forge 1.20.1 RecipeBookType implements IExtensibleEnum (create adds a constant); 26.3 RecipeBookType is a closed enum {CRAFTING, FURNACE, BLAST_FURNACE, SMOKER} sent in ServerboundRecipeBookChangeSettingsPacket
1.21 changelog: attribute modifiers are identified by a resource location instead of UUID+name; 26.3 AttributeModifier(Identifier, double, Operation)
1.20.1 AttributeModifier(String, double, Operation) used a random UUID; 26.3 needs an Identifier
1.20.1 AttributeModifier.getName(); 26.3 AttributeModifier is a record (id, amount, operation) without a name
1.20.1 Item.BASE_ATTACK_DAMAGE_UUID (UUID); 26.3 Item.BASE_ATTACK_DAMAGE_ID is an Identifier; AttributeModifierShim maps the UUID back to it
1.20.1 Item.BASE_ATTACK_SPEED_UUID (UUID); 26.3 Item.BASE_ATTACK_SPEED_ID is an Identifier; AttributeModifierShim maps the UUID back to it
1.20.1 Item.Properties.defaultDurability(int) set durability if none was set; 26.3 only has durability(int)
1.21: ResourceLocation constructors became private (use fromNamespaceAndPath); 26.3 Identifier(String, String) is private, Identifier.fromNamespaceAndPath is the factory
1.21: new ResourceLocation(String) removed (use parse); 26.3 Identifier.parse(String) defaults the namespace to minecraft like the old constructor
